title: Bauxite Stockpile Reclaimer
model_title: Bridge-Type Scraper Reclaimer for a Bauxite Blending Stockpile

introduction.definition: A bridge-type scraper reclaimer recovers bauxite from a blending stockpile. A harrow rakes across the whole pile face so material slides down to a chain scraper at the foot of the pile, which drags it to the yard conveyor. Because the pile was stacked in many thin layers, reclaiming the full face gives a well-blended feed to the refinery.
applications: Bauxite blending yards at alumina refineries
Coal, limestone and ore blending beds
key_points: Bridge travels slowly into the pile
Blending effect depends on number of stacked layers

pressure.title: Why full-face reclaiming blends the bauxite
pressure.description: The pile is stacked in many thin layers (chevron) along its length, each layer slightly different in quality. Raking the whole cross-section at once takes a slice of every layer, so the reclaimed bauxite has a much more uniform alumina, silica and moisture content — critical for stable digestion (blending ratio often 5:1 or better).

script.narration: This module introduces the Bauxite Stockpile Reclaimer.
A bridge-type scraper reclaimer recovers bauxite from a blending stockpile.
A harrow rakes across the whole pile face so material slides down to a chain scraper at the foot of the pile, which drags it to the yard conveyor.
Because the pile was stacked in many thin layers, reclaiming the full face gives a well-blended feed to the refinery.
Typical applications include bauxite blending yards at alumina refineries; coal, limestone and ore blending beds.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Bauxite Stockpile Reclaimer.
Check harrow tines and scraper chain.
Chain elongation and sprocket wear.
Replace chain/flights; structural inspection.
Watch for chain breakage: stop, spillage. Common cause: wear, sticky bauxite.
Watch for poor blending: feed grade swings. Common cause: too few layers, end effects.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
